name: 0 · Teste de Nível
description: Descubra seu nível (A1 a C1) fazendo o quiz de cada seção. O maior nível em que você acerta 75% ou mais é o seu nível atual.

flashcards.back: Quadro Europeu Comum de Referência para Línguas: escala internacional de níveis A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2. É a base de provas como TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge e Duolingo.
A = usuário básico (A1, A2). B = usuário independente (B1, B2). C = usuário proficiente (C1, C2).
Entende e usa expressões muito simples: se apresentar, perguntar nome/idade/onde mora, pedir coisas básicas, falar devagar e com ajuda.
flashcards.en: My name is Ana. I'm from Brazil.
flashcards.syl: mai nêim iz Â-nâ · aim fróm bra-ZÍU

flashcards.back: Fala de rotina, compras, trabalho, família e passado simples; resolve situações do dia a dia (restaurante, direções) com frases curtas.
flashcards.en: Yesterday I went to the supermarket.
flashcards.syl: IÉS-ter-dêi ai uênt tu dâ SÚ-per-mar-ket

flashcards.back: Se vira em viagens, conta experiências, dá opiniões e planos, entende o ponto principal de assuntos conhecidos (trabalho, escola, lazer).
flashcards.en: I've been learning English for two years.
flashcards.syl: aiv bín LÉR-ning ÍNG-lich fór tu IÉRS

flashcards.back: Conversa com fluência razoável, entende textos complexos de assuntos concretos e abstratos, argumenta e escreve textos claros. É o nível pedido por muitas vagas e universidades.
flashcards.en: If I had more time, I would learn another language.
flashcards.syl: if ai réd mór táim, ai uúd lérn â-NÂ-der LÉN-guich

flashcards.back: Usa o inglês com flexibilidade para fins sociais, acadêmicos e profissionais; entende textos longos e implícitos; expressa-se espontaneamente, com poucos erros.
flashcards.en: Had I known, I would have acted differently.
flashcards.syl: réd ai nôun, ai uúd rév ÉK-tid DÍ-fe-rent-li

flashcards.front: Qual a regra para descobrir seu nível neste app?
flashcards.back: Faça o quiz de cada seção (A1 → C1). Seu nível é o maior em que você acerta 75% ou mais sem consultar nada.

questions.question: I ___ a student.
questions.explanation: Com I usa-se am: I am (I'm) a student.
questions.en: I am a student.

questions.question: She ___ from Brazil.
questions.en: She is from Brazil.

questions.question: How ___ you?
questions.explanation: 'How are you?' = Como você está? You + are.
questions.en: How are you?

questions.question: I have ___ apple.
questions.explanation: Antes de som de vogal usa-se an: an apple.

questions.question: He ___ coffee every morning.
questions.en: He drinks coffee every morning.

questions.question: Monday, Tuesday, ___, Thursday.
questions.explanation: Wednesday (pronuncia-se 'uénzdei'). Muita gente erra a escrita.

questions.question: — Thank you. — You're ___.
questions.en: You're welcome.

questions.question: Yesterday I ___ to the market.
questions.en: Yesterday I went to the market.

questions.question: We ___ going to travel next month.
questions.explanation: be going to: we are going to + verbo.

questions.question: There isn't ___ milk.
questions.explanation: Em negativas e perguntas usa-se any. Milk é incontável: não usa 'many'.

questions.question: How ___ is this shirt?
questions.en: How much is this shirt?

questions.question: I ___ TV when the phone rang.
questions.explanation: Ação em andamento no passado interrompida por outra: past continuous + past simple.
questions.en: I was watching TV when the phone rang.

questions.question: I'm interested ___ music.
questions.explanation: interested in. Preposições fixas precisam ser memorizadas.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: Negativa no present simple: does not + verbo na forma base (sem -s).

questions.question: I ___ here since 2020.
questions.explanation: Since + ponto no tempo com ação que continua: present perfect.
questions.en: I have lived here since 2020.

questions.question: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
You ___ see a doctor. You look sick.
questions.explanation: should = conselho: você deveria ir ao médico.

questions.question: She used ___ in London.
questions.explanation: used to + verbo base = hábito/situação no passado.

questions.question: I haven't seen him ___ last week.
questions.explanation: since + ponto no tempo; for + duração (for two weeks).

questions.question: I'm not sure where he is. He ___ be at work.
The match was cancelled ___ the rain.
I'm looking forward ___ you.
questions.explanation: 'look forward to' é seguido de -ing (to é preposição).
questions.en: I'm looking forward to seeing you.

questions.question: If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.
questions.explanation: Segunda condicional (irreal): if + past; com be usa-se were para todas as pessoas.
questions.en: If I were rich, I would travel the world.

questions.question: If she had studied, she ___ the exam.
questions.explanation: Terceira condicional: if + past perfect, would have + particípio.

questions.question: The house ___ in 1990.
questions.explanation: Voz passiva no passado: was/were + particípio.

questions.question: He said that he ___ me the next day.
The woman ___ lives next door is a doctor.
questions.explanation: who para pessoas como sujeito da oração relativa.

questions.question: I wish I ___ more time.
questions.explanation: 'wish' + past simple = desejo sobre o presente (irreal).

questions.question: By this time next year, I ___ my degree.
questions.explanation: Future perfect: ação concluída antes de um momento futuro.

questions.question: I'd rather you ___ here.
questions.explanation: 'would rather' + pessoa diferente + past simple (presente irreal).

questions.question: Hardly ___ the room when the phone rang.
questions.explanation: Inversão após advérbio negativo (hardly): had she entered.

questions.question: Had I known, I ___ differently.
questions.explanation: Terceira condicional invertida: Had I known = If I had known.

questions.question: It was not until midnight ___ he finished.
He's ___ to be promoted next year; everyone says so.
questions.explanation: be bound to = com certeza vai (quase inevitável).

questions.question: Rarely ___ such a talented musician.
questions.explanation: Inversão com 'rarely': auxiliar antes do sujeito.

questions.question: We need to ___ a decision by Friday.
questions.explanation: collocation: make a decision (nos EUA também 'reach a decision').

questions.question: Which sentence sounds the most tentative (diplomatic)?
options: I might be mistaken, but I think there may be an error here.
questions.explanation: Hedging (might, may, I think) suaviza a crítica: típico de inglês profissional C1.

questions.question: They ___ my friends.
questions.en: They are my friends.

questions.question: He ___ coffee every day.
questions.en: He drinks coffee every day.

questions.question: ___ is your name?
questions.explanation: 'What is your name?' = Qual é o seu nome?
questions.en: What is your name?

questions.question: There ___ two books on the table.
questions.en: There are two books on the table.

questions.question: I ___ to the gym yesterday.
questions.en: I went to the gym yesterday.

questions.question: She is ___ than her sister.
questions.en: She is taller than her sister.

questions.question: We ___ visit Rome next summer.
questions.en: We are going to visit Rome next summer.

questions.question: ___ I open the window?
questions.en: Can I open the window?

questions.question: I ___ in this city since 2018.
questions.en: I have lived in this city since 2018.

questions.question: If it rains, we ___ at home.
questions.en: If it rains, we will stay at home.

questions.question: She ___ to play the piano when she was young.
questions.en: She used to play the piano.

questions.question: You ___ wear a seatbelt. It's the law.
questions.en: You must wear a seatbelt.

questions.question: The letter ___ yesterday.
questions.en: The letter was sent yesterday.

questions.question: He said that he ___ the report the day before.
questions.en: He said that he had finished the report.

questions.question: Rarely ___ such kindness.
questions.en: Rarely do we see such kindness.

questions.question: ___ I known, I would have helped.
questions.en: Had I known, I would have helped.

questions.question: The report must be accurate; ___, it will be rejected.
questions.en: The report must be accurate; otherwise, it will be rejected.
